notes: Added missing filter buttons for Vectors (AI/EPS), Data (TXT/JSON/CSV), and Presets. Added manual refresh button.

pages.title: 30+ File Types
pages.description: New support for Projects (AEP, PRPROJ, MOGRT), Fonts (TTF, OTF, WOFF), 3D (C4D, OBJ, FBX), LUTs (CUBE, 3DL), Scripts (JSX), Vectors (AI, EPS), Data (JSON, CSV, XML), and Presets (EPR).

pages.title: Organized Bins
pages.description: Each new file type gets its own color-coded bin in the project panel: Projects, Fonts, 3D, LUTs, Scripts, Vectors, Data, Presets. Auto-organize sorts them automatically.

pages.title: Filter Buttons
pages.description: New filter buttons in the sidebar to quickly show/hide Projects, Fonts, Scripts, LUTs, 3D, and other types.

about.welcomeText: Media Library 2.0 - Now with expanded file support!
